newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg PM says rates Portugal EMU chances good.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg PM says rates Portugal EMU chances good.

text.p: Portugal has every prospect of being in the vanguard of nations joining the European Union's single currency at the start of 1999, Luxembourg Prime Minister and Finance Minister Jean-Claude Juncker said on Monday.

"The government of Luxembourg believes that the adhesion of Portugal is a serious prospect," Juncker said in a statement issued after a meeting in Luxembourg with Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Guterres.
Juncker praised the massive efforts made by Portugal to prepare its economy for joining the third and final phase of European Economic and Monetary Union.
A decision on the initial members of the single currency is due to be made early next year.
Juncker said there could be no question of allowing a North-South division within the 15-nation European Union, rather the Maastricht treaty had to be applied as it stood.
Every one of the 15 member states must be judged on its own merits and against the terms of economic and monetary convergence, Juncker said.

Addressing the issue of the intergovernmental review of the Maastricht treaty, due to be completed by the middle of this year, Juncker and Guterres said each member state must retain the right to nominate a European Commissioner.
They added that the European Commission's right of initiative of legislation must also not be diluted.
